description.narrative: Breadfasts expansion is anticipated to contribute to job creation, both directly and indirectly, through the establishment of new facilities and the onboarding of delivery agents. Additionally, the project is expected to broaden market access for small and medium-sized enterprises (SMEs) in the retail distribution sector. Breadfasts platform will enable SMEs to reach more customers and benefit from essential services such as inventory tracking, marketing, and distribution, supporting their business growth. The project also aims to enhance the competitiveness of Egypts retail market by encouraging innovation and digitalization, addressing challenges such as market fragmentation, limited product selection, and inconsistent service quality.

IFC is considering an equity investment of up to US$13 million in Breadfast Inc. (Breadfast or Company), a leading online grocery and quick commerce brand in Egypt. The proposed project aims to accelerate Breadfasts expansion in the country.
